notes: «حدثني أبي» is a bare relation; «(رحمه الله)» is left out.
«وَ كَانَ فِي خِدْمَةِ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ الثَّانِي» describes Yahya and names no transmitter, so that Imam is not a link (rule 6).
The Imam named inside the chain after «عن» stays a narrator (owner ruling 2); «(ع)» is not part of the surface.
